title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot carefully. Notice the pattern of the data points. How do they relate to the functions provided?

title: Analyzing Function Options
text: Consider each function: $$\(f(x)=-x\)$$, $$\(f(x)=x\)$$, \(f(x)=x**2\), \(f(x)=abs(x)\). Which one can transform the x-values to fit the y-values in the scatterplot?

title: Testing Function \(f(x)=x**2\)
text: If \(f(x)=x**2\), can you find \(\beta_0\), \(\beta_1\), and \(\beta_2\) such that \(y_i=\beta_0+x_i*\beta_1+f(x_i)*\beta_2\) fits the data?
